scope: Summed Time Profiler sample weights across target threads; not wall time.

symbolication.scope: Only the exact original binary with matching recorded UUID is used. There is no rebuilt-image or function-byte-matching fallback.

aggregation.self: The first frame in each exported backtrace receives the complete sample count and weight.
aggregation.inclusive_frame: Each distinct loaded-image/name/PC location receives a stack's weight once.
aggregation.inclusive_function: Each distinct resolved loaded-image/function receives a stack's weight once; recursion is deduplicated after exact-image symbolication.
aggregation.unknowns: Unknown symbols remain identified by recorded image and PC. Unannotated frames are never assigned to the native image.
aggregation.time: Weights sum sampled CPU work across threads, not wall time. Inclusive totals overlap and must not be added as elapsed time.
